requirements.requirement: The system must include a 'confidence' object in every evaluation API response produced by the evaluate care facade when a quality score is returned.
The system must structure the 'confidence' object مطابق the schema defined in EVAL-CONF-ST-001, including completeness, recency, agreement, and overall fields.
The system must populate the 'confidence.overall' value using the output from the confidence calculation logic implemented in EVAL-CONF-ST-002.
The system must include the confidence object without altering or removing any existing fields in the evaluation API response.
The system must maintain backward-compatible JSON structure such that existing clients can parse responses without modification.
The system must attach the confidence object at the same hierarchical level as the quality score in the response payload.
The system must include confidence data for both provider evaluations and clinical trial evaluations when applicable.
The system must return numeric confidence values normalized to a consistent scale (e.g., 0 to 1 or 0 to 100) as defined in the schema.
The system must serialize the confidence object in valid JSON format with no null structural keys when data is available.
The system must not increase API response latency beyond acceptable thresholds defined for evaluation endpoints due to confidence integration.
The system must return a default confidence object with clearly defined fallback values when confidence calculation succeeds but partial input data is missing.
The system must omit or flag the confidence object with an error indicator when confidence calculation fails due to upstream service errors.
The system must still return the quality score even if the confidence calculation fails, without causing full API failure.
The system must ensure the evaluate care facade orchestrates and injects the confidence object before final response serialization.
